Evil Tuner XXL for the 64-bit MPCs and for Akai's plugin folder format (MPC OS 3.10.1). Same sound, pages and presets as 0.2.0, plus the Q-Link pages as the MACROXXL map (PET 3 = MIX, VOLUME; GATE 2 = DUCK REL, DUCK CH; MOD 3 = DEC, SUS, REL).

**Pick your zip**

| Zip | For |
|---|---|
| `Evil-Tuner-XXL-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` | Akai Force and the 32-bit MPCs (X, Live, Live II, One, Key 61 / 37), modded, MPC OS 3.x |
| `Evil-Tuner-XXL-<version>-mpc-aarch64.zip` | the 64-bit MPCs (Live III, XL, One G2, Key G2), modded, MPC OS 3.x |
| `Evil-Tuner-XXL-<version>-mpc-sdk.zip` | any MPC on MPC OS 3.10.1 or later: copy the folder into `VST2 Plugins`, no mod needed |

A pre-release until it has been tried on a device (`tested.json`); 0.2.0 was tested on an Akai Force (MPC OS 3.9.1). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sunskiefer/Evil-Tuner-XXL/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md); install steps in the [README](https://github.com/sunskiefer/Evil-Tuner-XXL#install).

Free, GPL-3.0-or-later. Tips: https://ko-fi.com/lcronx
